# pr-size-guard

> Measure pull request size from git numstat or unified diffs, ignore lock and generated files, flag warn and fail thresholds and suggest how to split the change into reviewable slices Python package `trysac-pr-size-guard`, import name `pr_size_guard`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
